author: Rinehart
text:
Hello Linos, thanks for commenting!

I don't love the idea of a hit to the pip on the LS because I can't see
anything on the LTF charts indicating a location for a LTF kink. The
cap is ideal for me. The number of candles in the caps was small.
Price exited the cap very forcefully.

A diamond is always a concern, but I honestly don't know how to analyze
the gap. I haven't come across the answer in my studies yet. Since it
is Friday, I could see price gapping to the gap supply or to the cap at
the open. So I would make sure to be flat or only have a pending at the
 gap supply for the Sunday open.

I do have access to Interactive Brokers charting platform. I was able
to find a kink but it is only visible on the 15 sec chart. I'm going to
 play a small position off the kink but it will be more for education
since it is more advanced. Other issue is spread...I've got 2 pips with
 IB which is great for this pair. I don't have this with my other
broker.

author: linos
text: Yes gaps are always a headache, IF says they are like trying to find Schrodinger's cat in a box!

author: Rinehart
text:
I am short on my tiny kink trade...but also on my real trade. I'm
short from the lower LS. SL above the cap+spread. If a diamond occurs,
 I'll be stopped out because I want to keep my SL tighter.

author: Rinehart
text: It seems LS to the pip was the winner...! Kink educational trade stopped out...lol. Real trade is open.
